# The Daily Clue

> A free daily word search puzzle at https://hearthandclue.com/. Every day there is one new 10x10 grid hiding eight words on a theme, and everyone gets the same puzzle that day. No login, no ads, nothing to install.

The Daily Clue is made by Hearth & Clue, which also sells printable word search and puzzle books.

## How it works

- A new puzzle appears at midnight in the player's own time zone.
- Words run in straight lines: across, down or diagonally, forwards or backwards.
- Players drag across a word to mark it, can reveal a word if stuck, and can share their result when finished.
- There are 30 themes, including camping, golf, quilting, gardening, fishing and cozy mysteries, with specials for Halloween, Christmas and Valentine's Day.
